relationships.justification: Chosen as a context image of crew training. It was taken on 18 October 1966 and does not depict the fire.

relationships.subject: doc-S67-15717
relationships.justification: Chosen as a context image of Spacecraft 012 in preparation. It was taken in January 1967 before the fire and does not depict it.

relationships.subject: doc-S67-19766
relationships.justification: Chosen as a context image of the crew at Launch Complex 34 during training. It does not depict the fire.

relationships.subject: doc-KSC-20170124-PH_KLS01_0129
relationships.justification: A 2017 museum photograph of the three-part hatch used on the Apollo 1 spacecraft. It is a later depiction of an artifact, not a record made in 1967.

relationships.subject: doc-KSC-20170124-PH_KLS01_0090
relationships.justification: A 2017 museum photograph of the redesigned hatch. It illustrates the engineering response and is not a record made in 1967.
